verdict.rationale: The only integration evidence is a first-party, bi-directional Salesforce sync, including sending lead scores. That shows HubSpot maintains native integrations, but none of the systems the story names. Missing for 10: documented Stripe or Shopify integration, a Segment/CDP connector, product-database sync, and an overview of the integration catalog with independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect the platform to my existing stack — Stripe or Shopify, a CDP like Segment, my product database — with maintained first-party integrations

citations.quote: Marketing Hub has a powerful bi-directional sync with Salesforce, which means that any changes made in one system are automatically synced to the other.
You can also send lead scores from HubSpot to Salesforce
